com.bulwark.reformat.notes: Nests with media inside (react frames) now become a 3-UP: person, media, person. Multicam clips are scaled to fill as a single camera instead of being stacked.

com.bulwark.captiontools.notes: New: find clips in a full episode and cut them into their own 16x9 sequences, and caption vertical clips in the house style (gold active word). Transcribes on your Mac (first use downloads a 640 MB speech model). Clip picking needs a Claude API key pasted at the bottom of the panel.
